import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Arc {
        int src, tgt;
        double cap;
        Arc(int s, int d, double c) {
            src = s;
            tgt = d;
            cap = c;
        }
    }

    static class Vtx {
        ArrayList<Integer> adj = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    static class FlowNet {
        ArrayList<Vtx> V;
        ArrayList<Arc> A;

        FlowNet(int nv, int na) {
            V = new ArrayList<>(nv);
            for (int i = 0; i < nv; i++) {
                V.add(new Vtx());
            }
            A = new ArrayList<>();
            A.ensureCapacity(na);
        }

        void add_arc(int s, int t, double c) {
            A.add(new Arc(s, t, c));
            V.get(s).adj.add(A.size() - 1);
        }

        int[] bfs_path(int src, int dst, double[] f, double[] cap) {
            PriorityQueue<int[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> Double.compare(b[0], a[0]));
            double[] dist = new double[V.size()];
            int[] prev = new int[V.size()];
            Arrays.fill(dist, 0.0);
            Arrays.fill(prev, -1);

            dist[src] = Double.MAX_VALUE;
            pq.offer(new int[]{(int) dist[src], src});

            while (!pq.isEmpty() && dist[dst] == 0) {
                int[] node = pq.poll();
                double c = node[0];
                int u = node[1];

                for (int idx : V.get(u).adj) {
                    Arc a = A.get(idx);
                    double res = a.cap - f[idx];
                    if (res > 0) {
                        double nc = Math.min(c, res);
                        if (nc > dist[a.tgt]) {
                            // Remove old entry if exists
                            Iterator<int[]> it = pq.iterator();
                            while (it.hasNext()) {
                                int[] entry = it.next();
                                if (entry[1] == a.tgt) {
                                    it.remove();
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                            dist[a.tgt] = nc;
                            pq.offer(new int[]{(int) dist[a.tgt], a.tgt});
                            prev[a.tgt] = idx;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            cap[0] = dist[dst];
            ArrayList<Integer> pathList = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = prev[dst]; i != -1; i = prev[A.get(i).src]) {
                pathList.add(i);
            }
            int[] path = new int[pathList.size()];
            for (int i = 0; i < pathList.size(); i++) {
                path[i] = pathList.get(i);
            }
            return path;
        }

        double calc_maxflow(int s, int t) {
            FlowNet res = new FlowNet(V.size(), A.size() * 2);
            double[] flow = new double[A.size() * 2];

            for (int i = 0; i < A.size(); i++) {
                res.add_arc(A.get(i).src, A.get(i).tgt, A.get(i).cap);
                res.add_arc(A.get(i).tgt, A.get(i).src, 0.0);
            }

            double total = 0.0;
            double[] bottleneck = new double[1];
            int[] p = res.bfs_path(s, t, flow, bottleneck);
            while (p.length > 0 && bottleneck[0] > 0) {
                for (int e : p) {
                    int rev = (e & 1) != 0 ? e - 1 : e + 1;
                    flow[e] += bottleneck[0];
                    flow[rev] -= bottleneck[0];
                }
                total += bottleneck[0];
                p = res.bfs_path(s, t, flow, bottleneck);
            }

            for (int idx : res.V.get(s).adj) {
                total += flow[idx];
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    static int rows, steps;

    static class Square {
        int r, c;
        long contagious;
        long reachable;
        int researchers, medkits;

        Square() {
            researchers = 0;
            medkits = 0;
            reachable = -1L; // all bits set
        }

        int index(int t) {
            return 2 + r + rows * c + rows * rows * t;
        }

        void seal_off() {
            reachable = 0;
        }

        void expose(int t) {
            if ((reachable & (1L << t)) != 0) {
                reachable &= ~(1L << t);
                contagious |= (1L << t);
            }
        }

        void infect_neighbors(int t) {
            if ((contagious & (1L << t)) != 0) {
                expose(t + 1);
                if (r > 0) arena[r - 1][c].expose(t + 1);
                if (r < rows - 1) arena[r + 1][c].expose(t + 1);
                if (c > 0) arena[r][c - 1].expose(t + 1);
                if (c < rows - 1) arena[r][c + 1].expose(t + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    static Square[][] arena = new Square[10][10];

    static String idx_to_str(int id) {
        if (id == 0) return "source";
        if (id == 1) return "sink";
        int r = (id - 2) % rows;
        int c = ((id - 2 - r) % (rows * rows)) / rows;
        int tm = (id - 2 - r - c * rows) / (rows * rows);
        return "(" + r + "," + c + "," + tm + ")";
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        rows = sc.nextInt();
        steps = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) {
                arena[i][j] = new Square();
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < rows; j++) {
                arena[i][j].r = i;
                arena[i][j].c = j;
                if (line.charAt(j) == 'Y') arena[i][j].seal_off();
                else if (line.charAt(j) == 'Z') arena[i][j].expose(0);
                else arena[i][j].researchers = line.charAt(j) - '0';
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < rows; j++) {
                if (line.charAt(j) != 'Y' && line.charAt(j) != 'Z') {
                    arena[i][j].medkits = line.charAt(j) - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int ts = 0; ts <= steps; ts++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < rows; j++) {
                    if (ts < steps) arena[i][j].infect_neighbors(ts);
                }
            }
        }

        FlowNet net = new FlowNet(rows * rows * (steps + 1) + 2, 100 * 4 * 60);
        for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < rows; j++) {
                Square sq = arena[i][j];
                if (sq.researchers != 0) net.add_arc(0, sq.index(0), sq.researchers);
                if (sq.medkits != 0) net.add_arc(sq.index(steps), 1, sq.medkits);
                for (int ts = 0; ts < steps; ts++) {
                    if (sq.medkits != 0) net.add_arc(sq.index(ts), sq.index(steps), 1000);
                    if ((sq.reachable & (1L << ts)) != 0) {
                        if (i > 0 && (arena[i - 1][j].reachable & (1L << ts)) != 0)
                            net.add_arc(sq.index(ts), arena[i - 1][j].index(ts + 1), 1000);
                        if (i < rows - 1 && (arena[i + 1][j].reachable & (1L << ts)) != 0)
                            net.add_arc(sq.index(ts), arena[i + 1][j].index(ts + 1), 1000);
                        if (j > 0 && (arena[i][j - 1].reachable & (1L << ts)) != 0)
                            net.add_arc(sq.index(ts), arena[i][j - 1].index(ts + 1), 1000);
                        if (j < rows - 1 && (arena[i][j + 1].reachable & (1L << ts)) != 0)
                            net.add_arc(sq.index(ts), arena[i][j + 1].index(ts + 1), 1000);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println((int) net.calc_maxflow(0, 1));
    }
}
